title: The Social Gaze of LLMs: A Literature Review of Multimodal Approaches to Human Behavior Understanding
reasoning: The paper identifies ethics as one of its four core analytical dimensions (RQ4) and includes a dedicated section (Section 7) evaluating how 176 publications address or overlook ethical risks, including moral reasoning, fairness, bias, and societal harms. This goes beyond a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section by making ethics a central subject of the systematic review and coding framework.
